Both Mantis Blades (doesn't count against their enhancements). With Combat Software (Spatial Mapping), active paired Jump Boosters or Reinforced Tendons, and a Mantis Blade hit in the last 2 Rounds, it's charged: once this fight, as a ROF1 Action, leap up to 8m at someone in sight (no MOVE spent, no penalties). If you reach them, your next blade hit deals +2d6 and ablates 2 extra SP.

Enhances: Mantis Blade

Item Compendium (2070) • Cyberware
